title: PlayerCore Travel Manual
summary: Use homes, back routes, spawn, random teleport, TPA, and warps without losing track of server rules.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: PlayerCore provides server-friendly travel and recovery commands. Its value is not speed alone: it gives players predictable routes back to bases, spawn, safe random locations, and shared warp points.

blocks.title: First Safe Habit
blocks.body: Set a home before leaving shelter, confirm the command message, and keep a normal route back until you trust the server's cooldowns and dimension rules.

blocks.title: What Matters In Play
blocks.body: Homes, back locations, random teleport, TPA, spawn, and warps all depend on permissions, cooldowns, and safety checks. Treat failed teleports as useful warnings.

blocks.title: Server Fit
blocks.body: Admins can tune limits, allowed dimensions, unsafe blocks, warp permissions, and message style. Ask for the server's rules before relying on cross-dimension travel.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a command fails, check whether the feature is enabled, the destination is safe, the cooldown is active, or the server blocks that dimension.
